svg.title: Technical arsenal
svg.desc: Technical arsenal. ai/ (LLMs, agents & retrieval): LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, Chroma, Groq, Gemini Realtime, LiveKit Agents, Vapi. backend/ (services & data): Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, Node.js, SQLite, Supabase, pytest. web/ (interfaces): TypeScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Start, Vercel. cms/ (client sites): WordPress, Elementor. automation/ (browsers & pipelines): Playwright, BeautifulSoup, openpyxl, Git, GitHub Actions. foundations/ (coursework in C, C++ & systems): C, C++, Assembly, Data Structures, DBMS, Operating Systems, Networks.
